name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for ADU construction in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for ADU construction in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Choose a contractor with **specific ADU experience**, proper licensing/insurance, and transparent communication. ADUs are not a good “first big project” for an untested builder.

Local permitting, tight backyards, and utility work make ADUs more complex than many people expect. Past ADU projects are your best indicator of future performance.

Key factors:
- Current license in good standing and proper insurance/bonding
- Documented ADU projects with references and photos
- Detailed, written scope of work, schedule, and payment terms
- Willingness to coordinate design, permits, and inspections

Interview multiple contractors, ask pointed questions about recent ADUs, and verify everything they tell you. Be wary of vague allowances or very low bids with little detail.

Established ADU builders in Los Angeles County will be comfortable walking you through process, costs, and likely challenges upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a licensed, insured contractor who has built multiple ADUs locally and can show references, photos, and permits from those jobs. Insist on a detailed written scope, schedule, and payment plan, and choose someone who clearly understands local ADU codes and permitting, not just general remodeling.
